function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_payments op WHERE op.order_id = o.order_id)
),
item_agg AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, sum(oi.price) AS price_sum
  FROM order_items oi JOIN q2 ON q2.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
correct AS (
  SELECT sum(price_sum) AS correct_price, count(*) AS order_cnt FROM item_agg
),
naive AS (
  SELECT sum(oi.price) AS naive_price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN q2 ON q2.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = oi.order_id
)
SELECT correct.order_cnt, correct.correct_price, naive.naive_price,
       naive.naive_price - correct.correct_price AS overcount
FROM correct CROSS JOIN naive;"}

)
SELECT correct.order_cnt, correct.correct_price, naive.naive_price,

  FROM order_items i

  (SELECT sum(amount) FROM r) AS all_amount,

  (SELECT count(*) FROM r) AS seller_count
FROM (SELECT 1) x;"}

response.answer:
2018 年 Q2（order_purchase_timestamp 在 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30 之间）同时具有商品明细与支付记录的订单共 19,947 个。正确商品总额（先按 order_id 把 order_items 的 price 汇总到订单级，再跨订单求和）为 2,858,289.74；直接把 order_items 与 order_payments 按 order_id 关联后再 sum(price) 得到的“朴素”商品总额为 2,970,843.84；被多算的金额为 112,554.10（虚增比例未验证）。

关联粒度解释：order_items 与 order_payments 都是订单的子表，粒度分别是“订单-商品明细行”和“订单-支付序列行”，一个订单可能有多条商品行、也可能有多条支付行（如分期/多支付方式）。两表直接按 order_id 内连接会形成多对多笛卡尔式膨胀：某订单若有 m 条商品行、n 条支付行，就会产生 m×n 行，每条商品价格被重复 n 次，因此 sum(price) 被放大。正确做法是各自先按 order_id 聚合（或仅用 IN/EXISTS 判断存在性）再关联，本查询即采用“先按订单聚合商品金额、再求和”的口径，并用 IN 子查询筛选同时具备两类记录的订单，避免膨胀。
